title: Uniform Matrix Hitting Points in Every Positive Characteristic
summary: We construct a single matrix substitution that detects every nonzero size- s division-free noncommutative formula in n variables over every field of a given positive characteristic. One deterministic machine, given a promised prime p in binary and n , s in unary, outputs matrices over 𝔽 p of dimension $`O(n^3s^6)`$ in polynomial bit time. The same tuple works with arbitrary extension-field coefficients, including in characteristic two. The construction also applies to the stated acyclic algebraic path programs.
family_title: Uniform black-box noncommutative identity testing across characteristics

review.reason: Constructs a uniform matrix substitution detecting noncommutative formulas over fields of positive characteristic.
